Which of the following is a concerted pericyclic reaction?
A. SN1 substitution of tert-butyl chloride
B. Diels-Alder cycloaddition of cyclopentadiene with maleic anhydride
C. Acid-catalyzed dehydration of 2-butanol
D. Free-radical chlorination of methane

A thermal [4+2] cycloaddition proceeds via:
A. A diradical intermediate
B. A zwitterionic intermediate
C. A single concerted transition state with suprafacial-suprafacial geometry
D. Stepwise nucleophilic addition followed by ring closure

In a thermal electrocyclic ring closure of (2E,4Z,6E)-2,4,6-octatriene, the stereochemistry of the product is governed by:
A. Conrotatory motion of the terminal lobes
B. Disrotatory motion of the terminal lobes
C. Antiperiplanar elimination
D. Anti-Markovnikov addition
